The Setup

Greg Riba appears in a viral video sitting in what looks like a back room, talking about gambling with the kind of flat conviction that either sounds completely obvious or completely insane depending on whether you understand it. The clip circulated widely in degen circles because it describes, with perfect precision, the psychological error that kills most traders: reducing position size when you are winning. "I swear to God 99% still don't get it. When you win, you start betting less. Bet more."

This is not a simple hype phrase. It is a specific assertion about positive expectation thinking, about the correct response to a confirmed edge, about what separates the people who build wealth through gambling from the people who grind it down through caution at the exact wrong moments. The token is named after the philosophy, runs on the philosophy, and has been kept alive for two years by a community that genuinely believes it.

"I swear to God 99% still don't get it. When you win, you start betting less. Bet more. If there's one roll you can make a hundred thousand dollars off — let it ride."

Pillar II

II  ·  The Philosophy

A Real Trading Framework, Encoded as a Token

The "Bet More" philosophy is not a meme about recklessness. It is a meme about discipline applied in the correct direction. Greg Riba's argument is that most people have the psychology of risk management precisely backwards: they cut winners, hold losers, reduce size when they are hot, and increase caution when their edge is most confirmed. The correct behavior, in his framing, is to do the opposite: recognize the winning position for what it is and let it grow rather than retreating out of habit or fear.

This maps directly onto the memecoin trading environment in an almost eerie way. The canonical error of the Solana degen is selling the 5x to "take profits" and watching it become a 100x. The canonical wisdom of the $BET MORE community is exactly the correction for that error: identify your winners and hold them, because the losers will cut themselves but the winners require the discipline to stay in. Every person who has ever rage-sold a 5x and watched it 10x again recognizes the philosophy instantly.

A token whose name is itself a reminder to hold your positions when they are working has a built-in psychological alignment with the behavior that leads to its own success. Every time someone sees $BET MORE in their wallet they receive the philosophy again as a prompt.

Bettor tier at 5 million tokens unlocks ten scans and deep holder analysis. Whale tier at 10 million tokens unlocks fifty scans and full platform access. As the scanner gains users, the demand for the token that unlocks it grows alongside it, independent of speculative price action.
